relevance_note: Case series of five Chinese children with HA20 from one hospital: "We identified five heterozygous variants in the TNFAIP3 gene among the five children".
method_note: I read the paper in full and used a short Python script to assemble the JSON, transcribing Table 1-3 cells by row label and patient column (the tables are transposed, so each table span runs from the row label through that patient's cell), then checked the output against the tables and verified every span as an exact substring of the paper. Internal inconsistencies were handled conservatively: the MMACHC variants/MMA are assigned to patient 3 in the Abstract and Discussion but to patient 2 in the Figure 1 legend and treatment section, so no MMACHC variant rows were emitted (patient 2's MMA diagnosis and hydroxocobalamin are recorded as the treatment section states); Table 3's 'Patient 3' column (c.133C>T: p. R45X) appears to be patient 4 and was not used; and patient 2's oral ulcers (Tables 1 and 3: NO; Discussion: present) are recorded both ways in phenotypic_features, with the checklist following the tables.
